Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Kusal Mendis and Pathum Nissanka will open the batting for Sri Lanka. Marcus Stoinis will begin with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Sri Lanka once again were exceptional with the ball. They started off well by picking up early wickets, and they did capitalize on the same by grabbing wickets in the middle overs. However, it was the last few overs that cost them. They leaked 58 runs in the last 5 overs, and let the game slip away a tad. Dushmantha Chameera was the leader of the pack, he grabbed 2 wickets and did not give away too many runs. The other bowlers did a fine job as well. Sri Lanka now need to chase 155, to end this series with a win. They are well and truly capable of doing so. But this time, they will have to step up with the bat. Who will come out on top? We will find out. Stay tuned!

After a disappointing start for Australia, they would be happy with the score they have put on the board. Openers once again perished early in the innings and it was Maxwell, Josh Inglis, and Marcus Stoinis who played cameos in the middle and tried to rebuild the innings. But they soon perished in trying to accelerate the innings. Eventually, it was the partnership of Wade and Sams, who put together 64 runs and guided Australia to a total of 154. However, Daniel Sams did perish soon, it was the innings of Wade who scored 43 runs, and helped Australia get out of trouble.

A good fightback from Australia! After losing their top-order, it was Wade and Sams who have guided Australia to a respectable total. But it's been another fine display of bowling from Sri Lanka. They have done a good job with the ball, but their bowling has been on cue throughout the series. It is their batting that was a concern. They are capable of chasing this down, but it is not going to be as easy.
A full ball, straying down the leg side. Agar shuffles across and looks to flick but misses. It is not given as a wide. Australia end at 154/6.
FOUR! Edged! Agar won't mind it! A full ball, outside off. Agar looks to go big but gets an outside edge, wide of short third man for a boundary.
Dushmantha Chameera bowling without any pace here. Full and outside off. Wade shuffles and paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Another slower ball, short and on middle, pulled way to deep square leg for a couple.
A slower, bouncer on middle. Wade misses his pull.

Review! Matthew Wade has reviewed a caught behind decision! The replays roll in. Nothing on Hotspot. Snicko too shows a flat line as the ball passes through the bat. The decision needs to be overturned. Matthew Wade survives!

NOT OUT! Short of a length, on middle, no pace there. Wade clears his front leg and looks to pull but gets some gloves on it and the ball lobs to the keeper who takes it. An appeal and up goes the finger. Wade though takes the review immediately. Hotspot shows nothing on it while Snicko shows it came off the arm and not the gloves. Decision changed and Matthew Wade survives.
Short ball, outside off. Wade looks to slash at it but gets a bottom edge, on a bounce and to the keeper. A single taken.
Ashton Agar comes to the crease now.
OUT! TAKEN! A length ball, on middle. Daniel Sams whacks it but only gets elevation, he holes one to deep square leg where Danushka Gunathilaka, the substitute fielder takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Danushka Gunathilaka b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length, on middle. Wade pulls it to square leg and the fielder there does well to half-stop it. Tree runs taken.
TWO WIDES! A full toss down the leg side. Sams misses his whip. The keeper gets a hand and stops it from running away. A single taken.
A single again as this fuller ball is hit to long off. Good over so far from Chamika Karunaratne.
A fuller ball, way outside off. Wade drills it to long off for a couple of runs.
Leg bye! A fuller ball, slower and on the pads. Sams misses his heave and the batters take a leg bye off the pads and to square leg.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on to bowl the 19th over.
SIX! Good end to the over! A fuller ball, on off. Wade stays back and powers it over long on for a biggie. A 50-run stand between these two.
A length ball, outside off. Sams steps across and forces it to deep backward point for one more.
Fuller ball, on middle. Wade drives it to deep covers for a single.
On middle, this is worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Matthew Wade tries to be cheeky as he opens the bat face very late and hits it to short third man. A quick single taken.
A length ball, outside off. Sams carves it to deep backward point for a single.
Wide! A length ball, slower and way outside off. Sams shuffles and leaves it in the end. Wide given.
Dushmantha Chameera (2-0-11-2) comes back to bowl.
A full toss and this is hit to long off for a single.
FOUR! Daniel Sams trying to up the ante now! A full ball, outside off. Sams steps back and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, angling on the pads. Sams steps across and flicks it uppishly and wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Wade punches it to deep extra cover for a single.
SIX! Hammered! On a length, on off, in the slot. Wade tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Wide! A full ball, angling way outside off. Wade leaves it alone.
Sees Wade shuffling across and Kumara serves it full and way outside off. Wade tries to play it towards third man but fails to connect. Good bowling.
Again angles it on the pads. Wade tickles it to short fine leg for one more.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sams makes room and guides it to covers for a run.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Full ball down the leg side. Wade misses his flick.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is full and on off. Wade reverse sweeps it in the gap through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played! Now Matthew Wade reverse sweeps this full ball to third man. Praveen Jayawickrama there gives a chase and tries to pull it near the fence but fails to clear it.
Full ball, drifting down the leg side. Wade shuffles and misses his sweep.
An off-cutter, outside off, tad fuller. Matthew Wade knocks it to long off for a single.
Another off pace delivery, on a length, around middle. Daniel Sams works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Wide! SLower ball, short and outside off. Daniel Sams hops and tries to cut this away but misses. Wide called!

On a length, around off. Matthew Wade taps it on the off side and scampers through to the other end. Chamika Karunaratne runs to his right to collect the ball, he sees Daniel Sams in his way and he just trips him over, not intentionally though. However, he apologies immediately after that. A single taken at the end.
Back of a length, around middle Daniel Sams is cramped for room there, as he leans and taps it towards point for a single.
Much fuller now, around middle. Daniel Sams works it away towards wide of long on. Two runs taken!
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Matthew Wade drags it with the inner half of his bat towards long on for a single.
Quicker and shorter, on middle. Daniel Sams blocks it out.
Fuller ball, on the stumps. Matthew Wade reverse-sweeps this towards point and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off. Matthew Wade leans and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Matthew Wade stays back and clips it towards deep square leg. Two runs taken!
Loopy again, full and outside off. Daniel Sams lifts it towards long off. The fielder there collects it on the bounce. One taken!
Fuller ball, tosses it up, on middle. Daniel Sams gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shorter ball, around middle. Matthew Wade pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace. What an over for Sri Lanka! Two big wickets off it!
Daniel Sams is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lahiru Kumara strikes once again in the over, and this time he gets the big fish, Glenn Maxwell! Lahiru Kumara drops it short this time, around middle and off. Glenn Maxwell leans back and tries to slash this to go over third man. But the ball goes off the bottom of the bat, and was the slower one as well. Dushmantha Chameera at third man takes an easy catch. Australia lose half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Dushmantha Chameera b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, around the pads, tad shorter Glenn Maxwell tucks it towards square leg for a brace.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on the thigh pads. Matthew Wade misses his flick and the ball brushes off his thigh pads and goes towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Matthew Wade comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! WOW! Chamika Karunaratne has taken a stunner! Marcus Stoinis could not believe it, but he does walk back. A slower ball, fuller and outside off. Marcus Stoinis tries to go over mid off, but miscues his shot and ends up just chipping it in front of mid off. Chamika Karunaratne there, runs forward, dives ahead, and takes a spectacular catch. Australia lose their fourth now.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamika Karunaratne b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Is that a clean catch? Marcus Stoinis is already walking back. Just one replay is needed to confirm it.
An off-pace delivery, short in length, down the leg side. Glenn Maxwell waits for it and pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Change. Lahiru Kumara is back into the attack.
Slower through the air now, fuller and outside off. Glenn Maxwell leans and pushes it towards cover for a single. He retains the strike!
Shorter now, around off. Marcus Stoinis knocks it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! WOW! What a shot! Quicker, outside off, tad fuller. Marcus Stoinis punches this past cover off the back foot for a cracking boundary.
Tad fuller, outside off. Glenn Maxwell taps it towards cover for a single.
Quicker now, flatter and outside off. Marcus Stoinis stays in the crease and cuts it towards sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
Shorter ball, on middle. Glenn Maxwell swivels and pulls it towards the fielder at deep square leg for a single.
Spin back into the action as Praveen Jayawickrama is back on.
Shorter ball, around middle, shaping back in. Marcus Stoinis looks to pull this but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Back of a length, around off. Marcus Stoinis pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! Full delivery now, around off. Marcus Stoinis muscles this over mid off for a biggie! He makes it look so easy!
Slower ball now, on a length, and on the pads. Marcus Stoinis taps it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Marcus Stoinis stays in his crease and tries to push this away, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length, on the pads. Glenn Maxwell tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is back into the attack. He went for 4 runs in his first over!
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, this is hit to point.
Wide! Full ball, way down the leg side. Maxwell tries to help it away but misses. Wided.
Lovely delivery! Short of a length, on off, nipping back in. Glenn Maxwell is squared up as he looks to push and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Length and on middle, Stoinis hits it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Marcus Stoinis comes to the crease now.

Review! Sri Lanka have reviewed a caught and bowled decision! The replay rolls in. Hotspot shows no mark as the ball passes through the bat. Snicko shows a spike as the ball passes through the gloves! The decision has been overturned. A successful review for Sri Lanka! Josh Inglis is not happy with that one. He walks back to the hut.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Short of a length, on off. Inglis is hurried as he tries to pull. He seems to miss it but the ball lobs up near the stumps and Chameera runs forward to take the catch. He takes it and appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Review taken after some conversation with the skipper. The replay shows that Inglis gets hit on the helmet. Hotspot confirms the same but guess what, Snicko shows a spike as the ball brushes the gloves. The third umpire is satisfied with the replays and he asks the on-field umpire to change his decision. Good review from Sri Lanka and the small partnership which was building is broken.
FOUR! Over mid off! A length ball, angling on middle. Inglis steps down and across and thumps it over mid off for a boundary. Smart batting as mid off was up.
SIX! BANG! This is full and on middle, was slower as well but Glenn Maxwell creates all the power to launch it over long on for a biggie. Much needed for Australia. 50 up as well!
Flatter, slower and on off. Inglis sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Another single as Glenn Maxwell works it to deep mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off. Inglis hits it uppishly and to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A loopy ball, outside off, driven through the fielder at point for a single.
Flatter and on middle, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana (2-0-4-0) is back on!
Length ball, outside off. Inglis drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

A length ball, just around off at 133 clicks. Inglis shuffles across and tries to paddle it but fails to get any bat there. Wow, the replay shows there was a little bit of deviation but there was no appeal from Sri Lanka.
Length ball, on middle. Maxwell gets cramped for the room but drills it to long on for a single.
On a length, on off. Maxwell steps across and taps it to point.
Short in length, on off. Inglis mistimes his pull to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Punched to deep covers for a single.
Bowling change! Chamika Karunaratne comes into the attack now.
FOUR! 14 coming off the over! Australia taking the charge now! This is full and on off. Josh Inglis lifts it over covers for another boundary.
A slider, around off. Inglis looks to work it away on the leg side but gets an inside edge, past the leg stump and to fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up, full and on off. Inglis goes inside out, over covers and bags a boundary.
Flatter and on off. Glenn works it to mid on for a single.
Good running! Short again and Maxwell pulls it to the longer side of the ground, to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Shorter and on off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! So, a good end to the Powerplay by the Aussies but still Sri Lanka will be happy with it. Short of a length, outside off. Maxwell ramps it away, no third man there and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Misfield! A full ball, on off. Maxwell powers it to the left of mid off and the fielder there dives but only half-stops. The ball still has legs to roll all the way to the fence.
A length ball, on middle. Maxwell defends it towards mid on.
On middle, on a length, this is nudged to square leg for a single.
Short of a length, around off and extra bounce as well. Inglis tries to ramp it away but gets beaten by the pace there. Sri Lanka on top here.
A full ball, on off. Inglis blocks it out.
Change. Lahiru Kumara is back on.
An arm ball, coming with the angle, on middle. Inglis tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
The man in form, Glenn Maxwell walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! Praveen Jayawickrama also strikes in his first over! A dream start this for Sri Lanka! Ben McDermott fails to go big once again. Tosses this one up, full and around off. Ben McDermott looks to heave this one the leg side, but gets a thick outside edge towards cover-point. Pathum Nissanka runs to his left and Charith Asalanka runs from point, for the catch. There is some miscommunication for the catch and they collide in the process. But Pathum Nissanka holds on to the catch safely, also no harm has been done! Ben McDermott walks back as Australia are 2 down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Praveen Jayawickrama

Commentary.Commentary: Much slower through the air now, full and around middle. Josh Inglis leans and taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length again, turning it away around off. Josh Inglis cuts it to the fielder at cover. No run there!
Another shorter one, around middle. Josh Inglis stays back and pushes it towards cover once again. Dot ball!
Praveen Jayawickrama begins with a shorter ball, outside off. Josh stays back and cuts it towards cover-point.
Change. Praveen Jayawickrama is introduced now to bowl.
Length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott looks to drive but misses. Another good over for Sri Lanka!
Josh Inglis is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dushmantha Chameera strikes in his first over and he draws first blood! Aaron Finch once again decides for the aerial route, but holes out this time. Another fuller ball, around middle, it nips away a touch as well. Aaron Finch steps down the wicket, and lifts it over mid on, but he does so with the bottom half of his bat and there is no timing on that shot. Lahiru Kumara runs backward and takes a sharp catch. A really good catch there and Sri Lanka have an early breakthrough!
Commentary.Howout: c Lahiru Kumara b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Aaron Finch takes the aerial route but it lands safely! A fuller ball, around off. Aaron Finch lifts it over mid off for a brace.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Aaron Finch stays back and looks to cut but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point. A single taken!
Back of a length, outside off. Aaron Finch looks to cut this away but gets an under edge towards point for a single.
First change in bowling sees Dushmantha Chameera into the attack.
Short, on middle. Ben McDermott, on back foot, defedns it out. Just 1 run off the over! What a start for Sri Lanka!
Quicker and shorter, outside off. Ben McDermott pushes it towards cover again, off the back foot. Another dot ball!
Shorter ball, around off. Ben McDermott pushes it towards cover. No run there!
Sower through the air, very full, around middle. Ben McDermott blocks it out.
Oh, dear! What a beauty! A fuller ball, around the off pole. Ben McDermott looks to heave this but misses. The ball was inches away from taking the off pole. Close call!
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Aaron Finch taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Ben McDermott ducks underneath it.
A length ball, around the leg pole. Ben McDermott shuffles across and tries to scoop this but misses. Good take from the keeper diving to his left.
Shorter ball, around off. Aaron Finch taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Good-length delivery, on the thigh pads. Ben McDermott tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Ben McDermott pushes it back to the bowler.

Lahiru Kumara begins with a fuller ball, on the pads. Aaron Finch flicks and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes towards mid-wicket for a single. There was an appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no!
Who will bowl from the other end? Lahiru Kumara it is.
A flatter ball, much straighter, on the stumps. Aaron Finch knocks it towards long on for a single. He retains the strike! 3 runs off the first over!

DROPPED! Oh, dear! An early chance goes down! Maheesh Theekshana cannot believe it is put down! A shorter ball, around middle. Ben McDermott pulls it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Janith Liyanage jumps to catch that, gets his hands to it, but fails to grab it! You have to catch those. Will this prove costly? One run taken!
Fuller now, on middle. Aaron Finch leans and taps it towards mid-wicket for a single. Aaron Finch and Australia are up and running!
Short again, turning it in on middle. Aaron Finch pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Shorter ball now, outside off. Aaron Finch stays back and pushes it towards cover. Another dot ball.
Maheesh Theekshana begins with a flat delivery, on the pads. Aaron Finch looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover.

All in readiness for the action. The players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch comes back to open the batting along with Ben McDermott. Spin to start the proceedings as Maheesh Theekshana to start with the ball. Here we go ...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kamil Mishara (In for Danushka Gunathilaka), Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis, Janith Liyanage (WK) (In for Dinesh Chandimal), Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Praveen Jayawickrama (In for Jeffrey Vandersay), Maheesh Theekshana, Lahiru Kumara.

Australia (Unchanged Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Ben McDermott, Josh Inglis, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Daniel Sams, Ashton Agar, Jhye Richardson, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Australia. They have elected to BAT first.

Sri Lanka did shuffle things up and tried Lahiru Kumara in the previous game. He didn't disappoint much as he chipped in 2 wickets. Something similar can be expected in this game with Praveen Jayawickrama and Ramesh Mendis having a go. With the series in their hand, Australia too can test their bench. Will Aaron Finch and his men whitewash Sri Lanka? Or will Sri Lanka end the series on a high? We will find out soon. Toss and teams news coming up shortly.

Hello and a warm to what is the final T20I of the series between Australia and Sri Lanka. The series has been already decided with the World Champions bossing the tour by going 4-0 up while nothing has ticked for the visitors so far who are still waiting for some positive outcome from this series. Australia have a chance to clean sweep while Sri Lanka can try something different and test their bench.
... MATCH DAY ...
